title: Contoso Trail Gear support triage result
description: Structured output contract for the fictional Contoso Trail Gear public product-support intake and triage workflow. Synthetic data only; never place real customer or company-confidential data in a workshop artifact.

ticket_id.description: Identifier supplied with the intake message. Echo it back unchanged.

category.description: Primary reason the customer contacted support.

product_line.description: Product family named or clearly implied in the message. Use unknown when the message does not say.

severity.description: s1_safety is reserved for possible injury or fire risk. s2_high blocks the customer from using the product. s3_normal is a routine issue. s4_low is informational.

safety_flag.description: True when the message describes injury, burn, fire, fumes, structural failure under load, or a similar risk to a person.

recommended_next_action.description: Single next step a support agent should take. The model proposes; a human decides.

missing_information.description: Specific facts that are absent and would change the triage decision. Empty array when nothing material is missing.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence in the classification. Treat it as a rough signal, never as a guarantee.

needs_human_review.description: True when safety_flag is true, confidence is below 0.6, or required information is missing.

rationale.description: Short justification grounded only in the intake message. No speculation about the customer.
